# Digo Academy

> Digo Academy is a premier cloud computing, DevOps automation, and AWS certification training platform offering expert-led live cohorts, self-paced courses, and practical hands-on labs.

Digo Academy bridges the gap between theoretical cloud concepts and real-world implementation. Our programs empower students and working professionals to prepare for industry-recognized certifications, advance their engineering careers, and master modern cloud architecture.

## Core Courses & AWS Certifications

- [AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner](https://digo.academy/courses): Comprehensive foundational training in cloud concepts, security, core AWS services, billing, and pricing models.
- [AWS Certified Solutions Architect Associate](https://digo.academy/courses): Practical architectural design principles covering resiliency, high availability, security, and cost optimization.
- [AWS Certified Developer Associate](https://digo.academy/courses): Cloud-native application development, serverless deployment, SDK integration, and CI/CD pipelines.
- [AWS Certified DevOps Engineer Professional](https://digo.academy/courses): Advanced automation, infrastructure as code (IaC), continuous integration, delivery systems, and monitoring.
- [AWS Certified Security Specialty](https://digo.academy/courses): Cloud governance, identity and access management (IAM), data protection, network security, and incident response.
- [AWS Certified AI Practitioner](https://digo.academy/courses): Fundamentals of Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning models, and generative AI services on AWS.

## Learning Approaches

- [Live Interactive Cohorts](https://digo.academy/batches): Structured live training batches with expert instructors, weekly milestones, collaborative peer learning, and live Q&A.
- [Self-Paced Learning](https://digo.academy/courses): On-demand high-definition video lessons, comprehensive study resources, and practical hands-on labs with lifetime access.

- [About Digo Academy](https://digo.academy/about): Learn about our mission, industry instructors, and student transformation stories.
- [Student Inquiries & Support](https://digo.academy/contact): Reach out to our admissions team for course guidance, custom training, or enterprise inquiries.
